author: Bellular News
description:
Discord is making messages from its biggest public servers searchable on the web. We look at whose messages are affected, the privacy setting you should check, and why Discord wants Google to send people its way. But Google's AI may take the answers without sending anyone back.

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!

00:00 Discord Opens the Gates
02:27 Whose Messages Go Public?
03:32 What Goes Public, and When
07:33 What's In It for Discord?
09:26 Google's AI Could Break the Plan
